breakdown.title: The House That Held a Village
breakdown.logline: A dreamer wanders through a house bigger inside than out: a European village with a curly-haired piper, impossible back stairs, a tiny room where a kind woman cooks, a short drive with an aunt, and a quiet ending with blue balloons.
breakdown.world_logic: The impossible is accepted as normal: a house contains a whole village, stairs appear where none should be, and tiny rooms hold a woman and a stove.

m1.text: Shot from outside, a few metres in front of the dreamer, at the dreamer's eye height, camera level with a 24mm lens. In the foreground, centered, the dreamer stands facing the camera, seen whole from about one third down to two thirds down the picture. In the middle distance, the cobblestone street stretches from behind the dreamer toward the village entrance. In the background, centered behind the dreamer, is the entrance to the village, with buildings on either side of the street. The scene is lit by natural daylight from the sky above. Just outside the picture on the left and right are the walls of the house where the dreamer stands.
